provenance: Real MedMNIST v2 BreastMNIST ultrasound images: the official test split, all 156, which the BreastMNIST models here are evaluated on and never trained on, with one known exception measured on the npz: test-split image 76 is a pixel-exact duplicate of training image 115 under the opposite label. Yang, Shi, Wei, Liu, Zhao, Ke, Pfister & Ni, 'MedMNIST v2 - A large-scale lightweight benchmark for 2D and 3D biomedical image classification', Scientific Data 10:41 (2023), CC BY 4.0. BreastMNIST is derived from Al-Dhabyani, Gomaa, Khaled & Fahmy, 'Dataset of breast ultrasound images', Data in Brief 28:104863 (2020). Licence: CC-BY-4.0 asserted by MedMNIST; the upstream BUSI grant is NOT verifiable; see DATA_LICENSES.md. Unlike the Wisconsin WDBC sample this page uses for the FHE/MPC pipeline, which is a different corpus. Scored here by medical_fl.resnet50, on exactly the rows medical_fl.resnet18 is scored on, because the published claim being tested is that the deeper network does WORSE: MedMNIST v2 reports ResNet-50 at AUC 0.857 against ResNet-18's 0.901.
split: the official BreastMNIST test split, whole, the same rows as medical_fl.resnet18

input.layout: samples[i] is a flat row-major 28*28 uint8 image, values 0-255

expected.note: Same rows as the ResNet-18 sample. A lower number here is the reproduction, not a failure.
